summary: AWS Marketplace: Customer seeing unexpected billing dimension (Dedicated GPU-hour) for Hosted API usage
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports AWS Marketplace bill shows usage recorded under an unexpected Dimension ("RW-Dedicated-GPUHour" / "dedicated_gpu_hours"), despite purchasing and using Redwood Hosted API (token-based).

Impact:
- Customer procurement/finance flagged the invoice as incorrect and paused PO confirmation for expanded usage.
- Potential over/incorrect charge classification (dimension mismatch), creates audit/procurement friction.

Customer details:
- Company: Zenith Media Labs
- Purchase path: AWS Marketplace subscription (public offer)
- Intended SKU: Hosted API (usage-based tokens)

Environment:
- Production
- Primary region: us-east-1

What the customer expected:
- AWS Marketplace line items tied to Hosted token dimensions (e.g., input/output tokens or total tokens) and/or embeddings units.

What they observed:
- Dimension on AWS bill shows GPU-hour based dimension (Dedicated) for the same billing period.
- Customer provided screenshots of AWS Marketplace invoice line items and the AWS "Usage" export.

Steps to reproduce (internal):
1) Locate Zenith Media Labs org in admin.
2) Confirm AWS Marketplace entitlement + offer code.
3) Compare:
   - Entitlement SKU in Redwood billing catalog
   - Meter emitted by metering pipeline
   - Dimension code configured in AWS Marketplace product
4) Validate what dimension codes were sent for metering events for the period 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-18.

Initial hypothesis:
Marketplace SKU -> internal meter mapping is incorrect for at least one offer code (or org is linked to wrong subscription), causing Hosted usage to be metered under a Dedicated dimension.

Requested outcome:
- Correct the mapping and ensure future usage reports under correct Hosted dimension.
- Determine whether prior charges need correction/credit (via AWS Marketplace process) and communicate expected timing to customer.

Evidence (customer-provided):
- AWS invoice line item: Dimension="RW-Dedicated-GPUHour" (quantity aligns with token volume, not actual GPU-hours)
- AWS cost allocation CSV excerpt (redacted) showing product code + dimension.

Internal notes:
- Similar symptoms mentioned in Slack #eng thread "billing-dimension-mismatch-found" (2026-02-??).
comments: 2026-02-19 - Dev Patel (Support): Acknowledged receipt. Asked customer for: AWS account ID (payer), Marketplace subscription ID/offer ID, and billing period affected. Opened escalation to Billing/Metering (Cole Summers / Nadia Rahman).

2026-02-19 - Rachel Kim (Enterprise Onboarding): Adding context: customer is procurement-led, they need invoice dimension naming to match their internal GL mapping. They’re okay with credits later, but want confirmation today that this is a known issue and being addressed.

2026-02-19 - Cole Summers (Billing/Metering): Pulled org + entitlement. Org is linked to AWS entitlement code awsmkt:offer-9f3a… (redacted). In our billing catalog, that offer code currently maps to meter_id=dedicated_gpu_hours (this looks wrong). Investigating if this is a catalog config regression vs a bad row in the marketplace SKU table.

2026-02-19 - Nadia Rahman (Metering/Telemetry): Confirmed metering events emitted from usage pipeline include marketplace_dimension="RW-Dedicated-GPUHour" for this org since 2026-02-03. No evidence of the org actually being on Dedicated capacity; requests served via Hosted clusters. Looks like purely a mapping/config issue, not service delivery.

2026-02-20 - Cole Summers (Billing/Metering): Root cause identified: AWS offer code for Hosted API "Hosted-Usage-v2" was mistakenly associated with Dedicated dimension during SKU catalog v2 backfill. This appears limited to a subset of early test offers created during the listing refresh staging-to-prod cutover. Creating fix referencing billing catalog update PR and will coordinate with Finance for correction path.

2026-02-20 - Emily Stone (Revrec/Accounting): For AWS Marketplace, we can’t directly edit an issued AWS invoice line item. We can request an AWS Marketplace refund/credit (within policy window) or apply a commercial credit via private offer adjustment depending on customer preference. Need confirmation of amount + impacted period.

2026-02-21 - Cole Summers (Billing/Metering): Fix prepared and reviewed in billing catalog. Referencing: github/redwood/pr-19874-add-marketplace-sku-ids-to-billing-catalog. Once merged, new metering events will use the correct Hosted token dimension. For historical: we can provide customer a reconciliation statement mapping their billed quantity to tokens, and initiate AWS credit request if they want it corrected on AWS side.

2026-02-21 - Dev Patel (Support): Customer update sent: confirmed this is a configuration/mapping issue, service usage is Hosted, not Dedicated; fix underway; offered options for credit/reconciliation. Customer requested AWS-side credit note if possible + written explanation for procurement.

2026-02-22 - Cole Summers (Billing/Metering): PR merged and deployed to prod billing catalog at 2026-02-22 03:10 UTC. Verified new metering events now emit marketplace_dimension="RW-Hosted-Tokens" (exact code: RW-Hosted-TokenUnits-v2) for Zenith Media Labs.

2026-02-22 - Nadia Rahman (Metering/Telemetry): Post-deploy validation: last 2 hours of metering look correct. No other orgs currently emitting the wrong dimension based on quick scan of top AWS offer codes, but we should run a fuller backfill check as follow-up.

2026-02-23 - Dev Patel (Support): Sent customer: (1) confirmation of fix + timestamp, (2) reconciliation statement for 2026-02-01..2026-02-22 showing tokens vs the dimension quantity they saw, and (3) next steps for AWS Marketplace credit request. Customer confirmed they can proceed with internal approval pending credit request submission.
resolution:
Resolved by correcting AWS Marketplace offer code -> internal meter mapping in Redwood billing catalog so Hosted usage is metered under the correct Hosted token-based billing dimension.

Resolution details:
- Fix deployed: 2026-02-22 (billing catalog update; reference PR: pr-19874-add-marketplace-sku-ids-to-billing-catalog)
- Validation: New metering events for customer now emit Hosted token dimension code; no Dedicated dimension emitted post-fix.
- Customer comms: Provided written explanation and reconciliation statement for procurement.
- Financial remediation: Finance to submit AWS Marketplace credit/refund request for the impacted billing period (tracking handled outside Jira).
next_steps: Run a one-time audit of all active AWS offer codes to detect any additional mis-mapped dimensions (owner: Nadia Rahman).
Add a pre-deploy check in billing catalog CI for marketplace offer code <-> meter_id consistency (owner: Cole Summers).
Update Support macro for marketplace billing issues with reconciliation + escalation path (owner: Dev Patel).
